items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: feel like old Ned, what did I do to be so black and blue.

ctx.x: Willie Smith was Willie the Lion.

That's right. And so we made this date and on the way back, on the way up we were taking a cab just Louis and myself and I was telling Louis, I said ...... Oh, and first of all Louis was telling me about a song in the show, he says it was a killer, this is a killer McPartland. He used to call me McPartland, McPartland. He says it's a great number in the show he says called 'Black and Blue' you know. And I said, yes, how does it go? So he sang it to me. (SINGS). "old empty bed, springs hard as lead, wish I was…

So I loved the song and we'd sing in harmony you know. (SINGS).......... He's singing higher to me and I could hear the harmony. So he taught me the song on the way up, on the way up to see Willie the Lion Smith, at Rod and Jerry's up in Harlem you know.
